verdict.rationale: The evidence pack names no supported ID document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) and publishes no country/document coverage list. The '200+ countries' claim covers business registry checks, not government ID documents. Tamper detection on altered documents and document-free government-source checks are adjacent capabilities, not documented ID coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published
